title: 艾尼维亚·雪花风铃
description: 冰晶凤凰轻收双翼，站在圆润冰台上看纸雪花小风铃，冰蓝羽片清楚可辨。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Anivia is a magnificent ice phoenix with layered crystalline blue feathers, a long elegant neck, a pointed icy crest, sweeping wings, and a fan of long angular tail feathers. Keep her bird anatomy and unmistakable frozen facets while softening every edge into chunky wax-crayon shapes. Her eyes appear calm and bright, and both clawed feet rest securely on a broad rounded ice perch.
art_direction.scene: She tilts her head toward a tiny paper snowflake mobile suspended from a low winter branch, one wing half opened as a gentle visual echo. The setting is a quiet blue garden with only two rounded snow mounds and a small evergreen silhouette. Keep all wing and tail tips inside the frame and the mood serene.
art_direction.palette: ice blue, cobalt, lavender shadow, snowy cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
